correctness.rationale: For any m-vertex tree m>=2 and n resource coordinates n>=m, cube condition each vertex appears literally among n entries. A permutation with c cycles fixes cell tuples constant on each cycle; for j edge cycles orientation contributes (-1)^(sum_lengths-j) and alternating cell degree multiplies to (-1)^j. Exact cellular Lefschetz formula L=Σ_j(-1)^j C(c,j)(m-1)^j Surj(c-j,m)=Σ_h(-1)^h C(m,h)(1-h)^c. Kozlov sphere-wedge theorem confines reduced homology to n-m, with dimension F_m(n). Thus trace =sgn(σ)F_m(c(σ)). The averaged signed cycle count is a falling factorial a(a-1)...(a-n+1)=0 for all a∈[1,m-1], proving rational quotient acyclicity even at n=m (discrete m! points). Independent direct oriented cubical-cell enumeration checked all permutations for six small parameter pairs up through (4,4), with complete symbolic all-parameter proof.
